verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs describe a management API for programmatically creating, rotating, and distributing API keys, plus workspace-level budgets for capping spend per team — all without requiring users to expose raw provider keys (BYOK is optional). A community engineer independently confirms this is a standout feature: 'One thing that OpenRouter makes easy is the ability to manage API keys (mint new ones, expiry/limits per key, etc.)'.
